self, in_features: int, out_features: int, rank: int, bias: bool = True, dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32, device: Optional[torch.device] = None, ) -> None: super().__init__() self.in_features = in_features self.out_features = out_features self.rank = max(1, min(rank, in_features, out_features)) # Factorized low-rank parameter tensors self.V = nn.Parameter( torch.empty(self.rank, in_features, dtype=dtype, device=device) ) self.U = nn.Parameter( torch.empty(out_features, self.rank, dtype=dtype, device=device) ) if bias: self.bias = nn.Parameter( torch.empty(out_features, dtype=dtype, device=device) ) else: self.register_parameter("bias", None) self.reset_parameters() @property def weight(self) -> torch.Tensor: """Reconstructed effective weight matrix for compatibility.""" return torch.matmul(self.U, self.V) def reset_parameters(self) -> None: """Kaiming uniform parameter initialization.""" nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.V, a=math.sqrt(5)) nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.U, a=math.sqrt(5)) if self.bias is not None: fan_in = self.in_features bound = 1 / math.sqrt(fan_in) if fan_in > 0 else 0 nn.init.uniform_(self.bias, -bound, bound) def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: """ Forward pass executing factorized low-rank multiplication: y = (x @ V^T) @ U^T + bias """ intermediate = F.linear(x, self.V) out = F.linear(intermediate, self.U, self.bias) return out @classmethod def from_linear( cls, linear: nn.Module, rank: int, covariance: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, ) -> DynamicSVDLinear: """ Construct factorized DynamicSVDLinear directly from dense nn.Linear or Conv1D via SVD. Args: linear: Source dense linear or Conv1D layer (or LoRALinear wrapper). rank: Target rank for low-rank factorization. covariance: Optional empirical activation covariance C_X for activation-aware SVD. Returns: DynamicSVDLinear: Initialized factorized low-rank layer. """ target_mod = getattr(linear, "base_layer", linear) cls_name = target_mod.__class__.__name__.lower() is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(target_mod, "nf") raw_w = target_mod.weight.data if is_conv1d: in_f, out_f = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1] W = raw_w.t().float() # [out_features, in_features] else: out_f, in_f = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1] W = raw_w.float() # [out_features, in_features] target_rank = max(1, min(rank, in_f, out_f)) new_layer = cls( in_features=in_f, out_features=out_f, rank=target_rank, bias=target_mod.bias is not None, dtype=target_mod.weight.dtype, device=target_mod.weight.device, ) if covariance is not None and covariance.numel() > 0: # RESEARCH FIX: Activation-aware whitening SVD with eigenvalue clamping lambda_i >= 1e-4 cov = covariance.to(device=W.device, dtype=torch.float32) try: # Eigen-decomposition with regularized eigenvalue clamping >= 1e-4 eigvals, eigvecs = torch.linalg.eigh(cov + 1e-4 * torch.eye(in_f, device=W.device)) eigvals_clamped = torch.clamp(eigvals, min=1e-4) cov_sqrt = eigvecs @ torch.diag(torch.sqrt(eigvals_clamped)) @ eigvecs.t() cov_inv_sqrt = ( eigvecs @ torch.diag(1.0 / torch.sqrt(eigvals_clamped)) @ eigvecs.t() ) W_scaled = W @ cov_sqrt U_svd, S_svd, Vh_svd = torch.linalg.svd(W_scaled, full_matrices=False) # Truncate and un-whiten right singular factors sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S_svd[:target_rank], min=1e-12)) U_r = U_svd[:, :target_rank] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0) V_r = ( sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * (Vh_svd[:target_rank, :] @ cov_inv_sqrt) ) # Symmetrically normalize factor magnitudes norm_u = torch.norm(U_r, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-8) norm_v = torch.norm(V_r, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-8) scale = torch.sqrt(norm_u / norm_v) U_r = U_r / scale V_r = V_r * scale except Exception as e: logger.warning( f"Activation-aware SVD failed ({e}), falling back to standard SVD." ) U_svd, S_svd, Vh_svd = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False) sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S_svd[:target_rank], min=1e-12)) U_r = U_svd[:, :target_rank] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0) V_r = sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vh_svd[:target_rank, :] else: # Standard weight SVD U_svd, S_svd, Vh_svd = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False) sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S_svd[:target_rank], min=1e-12)) U_r = U_svd[:, :target_rank] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0) V_r = sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vh_svd[:target_rank, :] new_layer.U.data.copy_(U_r.to(dtype=target_mod.weight.dtype)) new_layer.V.data.copy_(V_r.to(dtype=target_mod.weight.dtype)) if target_mod.bias is not None and new_layer.bias is not None: new_layer.bias.data.copy_(target_mod.bias.data) return new_layer def extra_repr(self) -> str: return f"in_features={self.in_features}, out_features={self.out_features}, rank={self.rank}, bias={self.bias is not None}" class DynamicEntropySVDCompressor(BaseCompressor

self, model: nn.Module, rank: int = 64, sparsity: float = 0.5, structured_24: bool = True, max_error: float = 0.35, target_attention_only: bool = False, fallback_to_original: bool = True, max_retries: int = 2, target_modules: Optional[List[str]] = None, cfg: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any, ) -> None: super().__init__(model, name="enlighten", **kwargs) cfg = cfg or kwargs.get("comp_config", None) self.cfg = cfg self.rank = int(_cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))) self.sparsity = float(_cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_sparsity", _cfg_get(cfg, "sparsity", sparsity))) self.structured_24 = bool(_cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_structured_24", _cfg_get(cfg, "structured_24", structured_24))) self.max_error = float(_cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_max_error", _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error))) self.target_attention_only = bool( _cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_target_attention_only", _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)) ) self.fallback_to_original = bool( _cfg_get(cfg, "enlighten_fallback_to_original", _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)) ) self.max_retries = int(max_retries) self.target_modules = target_modules self.compressed_layers: List[str] = [] self.fallback_layers: List[str] = [] self.skipped_layers: List[str] = [] self.layer_ranks: Dict[str, int] = {} self.layer_sparsities: Dict[str, float] = {} self.layer_errors: Dict[str, float] = {} def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool: """Determine if a module is targeted for ENLighten compression.""" name_lower = name.lower() if any(part in name.split(".") for part in ["lora_A", "lora_B", "base_layer"]
